provider: ICU; globalization invariant mode false; Linux libicuuc.so.74
canonicalRepresentative: Minimum Unicode scalar in each BCL StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase equivalence class, found by ascending exhaustive Dictionary insertion; dictionary equality resolves hash collisions.
stringCompositionEvidence: OrdinalCasing.CompareStringIgnoreCase compares each BMP character or valid surrogate pair independently and preserves UTF-16 width; no context, expansion or normalization. Generator checks every scalar alone and embedded beside NUL, ASCII, a supplementary character and a combining mark.
scope: Valid Unicode scalar strings only. This is an observed .NET ICU baseline, not a claim about every Windows NLS/ICU or .NET Framework version. Run exhaustive BCL differential on Windows production provider; any table mismatch fails instead of silently approximating. Rust runtime has no CLR or ICU dependency.
